stories.title: Andrew Novak Wins Mexico Open — Tournament-Record 25-Under, First Solo PGA Title [TIER 1]

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
ANDREW NOVAK WINS THE MEXICO OPEN.

25-under 259 — a NEW tournament record.

First solo PGA Tour title for the 31-year-old.
$1,080,000 prize.

Wofford to PGA champion. What a story.

#GolfFanrecap #PGATour #MexicoOpen

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
Novak had a 6-shot lead at the Mexico Open.

Then it became 3.

Then birdies on 12, 13 AND 14 slammed the door.

25-under. Tournament record. First solo PGA title.

Andrew Novak is a champion. #GolfFanrecap #PGATour

article.headline: Andrew Novak Wins Mexico Open at Tournament-Record 25-Under, Claims First Solo PGA Title

stories.title: Fichardt Claims Simmons Bank Championship with Final-Hole Eagle — Edges Johnson [TIER 1]

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text:
DARREN FICHARDT WINS THE SIMMONS BANK CHAMPIONSHIP.

An eagle on the final hole.
One shot over Zach Johnson.

22-under 194 on the PGA Tour Champions circuit.

Drama at 18. #GolfFanrecap #PGATourChampions

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text:
Fichardt's eagle at 18 didn't just win the tournament.

It moved the needle in the Charles Schwab Cup standings.

One hole. One swing. Everything changed.

#GolfFanrecap #PGATourChampions #SchwabCup

article.headline: Fichardt Makes Eagle on Final Hole to Win Simmons Bank Championship, Edge Zach Johnson by One

stories.title: Who Is Andrew Novak? From Zurich Classic Pairs Win to Solo PGA Champion [TIER 2]

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
Andrew Novak lost a playoff to Justin Thomas.

Then won the Zurich Classic at his 100th start (with Ben Griffin).

Now he's a SOLO PGA Tour champion at the Mexico Open.

This is one of golf's best stories right now. #GolfFanrecap #PGATour
